title: Grilled Anticuchos with Peruvian Chimichurri
description: A traditional Peruvian dish featuring marinated beef heart skewers grilled to perfection and served with a tangy chimichurri sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner.
instructions: Combine beef heart, ají amarillo peppers, red onion, garlic, and olive oil in a large bowl. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread marinated beef heart onto skewers.
Grill skews for 8-10 minutes per side, or until beef is cooked to desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, combine chimichurri sauce and parsley in a small bowl.
Serve grilled anticuchos with chimichurri sauce spooned over the top.
